title: The Mughals Laying of Seige Around (Banda Singh)

blocks.text: Those around Banda complain that deception has trapped the poor and simple while others escaped, and the phrase garib niyane gives the moral center of that complaint.
Banda answers that he knew the Turks had come to kill him, but the explanation no longer heals the breach created by the failed strategy.
The page is about recrimination under pressure, with garib niyane naming those left to bear the cost.
